_readme: Copy this file to config/local-ai.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR values.
Every script reads config/local-ai.json; command-line parameters override it.
Use forward slashes in paths: valid on Windows, and safe inside JSON.
Run `pwsh -File scripts/detect-hardware.ps1` to get the values marked (detect).
_llamacpp_dir: Folder that contains llama-server and llama-bench. Download a release for your GPU backend (CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, Metal) from https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases.
_hf_cache: Where GGUF files live. `hf download <repo> <file>` stores them here when HF_HUB_CACHE points to it. Put it on your fastest, largest drive; models are 2-20+ GB each.
_server: Keep 127.0.0.1 unless you need LAN access (then also set --api-key in the launcher).
_models_max: How many models the router keeps loaded at once. 1 for a single consumer GPU; raise only if two models plus their KV caches fit in VRAM at the same time.
_threads: (detect) Number of PHYSICAL CPU cores, not logical threads. Hyper-threading rarely helps token generation and often hurts it.
_python_cmd: (detect) Interpreter used by the eval harness and promptfoo: `py` on Windows with the launcher, `python3` on Linux/macOS, or a venv path.
_results_dir: Where benchmark logs go, relative to the repo root. Gitignored by default: results describe your machine.
